# Python dependencies — Pediatric AML single-cell atlas
#
# Two groups. The first are the versions named in the manuscript Methods; those are
# what produced the published results and are what to install to reproduce them.
# The second are packages the code imports that the Methods does not name a version
# for; the version given is the one present in the authors' current environment,
# which post-dates the analysis for some packages. Install the Methods-pinned set
# exactly; treat the second group as a floor, not a guarantee.
#
# Tested on Python 3.14.

# ---- versions stated in the manuscript Methods ----
scanpy==1.12.1
anndata==0.12.16
numpy==2.4.6
scipy==1.17.1
scikit-learn==1.8.0
statsmodels==0.14.6
lifelines==0.30.3

# ---- imported by the shipped code, version not stated in Methods ----
# (observed in the authors' environment at 2026-10-14)
pandas>=3.0.6
matplotlib>=3.11.2
h5py>=3.16.0
pillow>=12.3.0            # PIL, used by the composite/stitching scripts
pymupdf>=1.28.2           # provides `fitz`
seaborn>=0.13.2
wordcloud>=1.9.6
python-docx>=1.2.0        # caption/table builders only
adjustText                # label de-overlap in several panels
cellxgene-census          # Figure 6 normal-tissue pull (CZ CELLxGENE Census)
tiledbsoma                # backend for cellxgene-census

# h5py, anndata, scanpy, cellxgene-census and tiledbsoma are needed only by the
# BUILDER scripts that read the large AnnData objects or query the Census. The
# per-figure renderers, which read the shipped plot-level tables, do not need them.
